notes: Page headed "STATION 93" (the report's own station number) and "SPRING - MRS. NELL K. REAM" (faint typescript; the owner name is read from an enlarged copy and the letters of "REAM" are weak). Location gives only latitude and longitude. Description: covered pool in alluvium on sandstone in creek bed; discharge measured at inflow to settling box. Three dates; Apr. 13 has no year printed and follows Feb. 15, 1949. Discharge printed in second-feet and gallons per minute. No place, county or state on the page.
